title: narumi API transcription selection and retry definitions

transcription_model_provider.description: Implemented API transcription adapter. Availability of this adapter does not imply a connection or model is ready.

transcription_model_id.description: Explicit timestamp-capable OpenAI transcription model. Other audio models may be displayed as unsupported but cannot be selected.

api_transcription_language.description: The shared meeting language used by API transcription. auto omits the API language field. Otherwise require a real lowercase two-letter ISO 639-1 code; membership is validated by the implementation before sending.

transcription_model_parameters.description: No custom API transcription parameters are supported. prompt, vocabulary hints, speaker names/reference audio, response format, language, runtime overrides, credentials and Responses API options are rejected. The adapter fixes its model-specific wire parameters.

cache_epoch.description: Attempt authorization epoch. Increasing it alone never authorizes retransmission of an unknown chunk and never resends a verified successful chunk. A matching transcription_retry confirmation is also required for one unknown chunk.

transcription_model_selection.description: Explicit API transcription override requiring api_ok, an enabled matching-revision API-key connection, verified model timestamp capabilities and an unexpired model. Keep transcription_engine unchanged as the local selection and use this override only while non-null. Audio is sent separately for microphone and system tracks, with possible API charges. Saving or listing this selection does not send audio. Initial API transcription sends no vocabulary prompt; shared vocab_hints remain available to transcript integration.

transcription_model.description: Nullable transcription-only model override. Omitted updates retain the saved selection; null clears it and restores the saved transcription_engine. Missing in existing saved configs means null and preserves local transcription behavior.

transcription_fingerprint.description: Lowercase SHA256 fingerprint of the confirmed transcription plan or chunk. Not a credential, arbitrary path or model-generated value.

transcription_retry.description: One explicit retransmission confirmation for an outcome-unknown chunk, never a saved config field. Before any audio request the server must match both fingerprints and the latest blocked epoch against the current plan and ledger, require selected cache_epoch > blocked_epoch, and reject stale confirmation without sending. The pending attempt consumes this confirmation atomically; a further unknown outcome needs a new confirmation. Successful chunks are reused and other unknown chunks are not automatically resent.

chunk_index.description: Zero-based index in the ordered microphone-then-system transcription plan. Must be less than chunk_count.

completed_chunks.description: Number of verified successful chunks in the current plan, not an API processing or billing count. Must not exceed chunk_count.

transcription_outcome_unknown_details.description: Safe, typed recovery information for an API transcription request whose outcome is unknown. Construct only from validated local plan/ledger fields; never include upstream error bodies, transcripts, credentials or paths. Sample bounds are track-relative half-open intervals; implementation also validates start < end, chunk length <= 9600000, indices/counts and total audio <= 24 hours at 16000 Hz. Limits of 144 chunks and 24 hours are application send limits, not cost or API-attempt guarantees. Cancellation after sending cannot guarantee server-side processing or billing stopped.
